$comment: DRAFT — NOT IN FORCE. This sector's status is `provisional` in the sector catalog: no delegated act binds it yet, so this schema is our best reading of an instrument that has not been ratified and its field set may change without a migration path. Structural validation against it is not evidence of compliance, and a passport issued against it may not be representable once the act lands. The go sign is a single edit: set "status": "in_force" in crates/dpp-domain/sectors/<key>.json. CI then requires this marker to be removed.
title: Odal Node — Construction Products Sector Data (v1.0.0)
description: Construction products fields per EU CPR 2024/3110. Mandate is phased by product family (~2028-2032). This schema is provisional pending final delegated acts.

co2ePerFunctionalUnitKg.description: Carbon footprint in kg CO2e per functional unit.

functionalUnit.description: Description of the functional unit, e.g. 'per tonne', 'per m2', 'per m3'.

recycledContentPct.description: Recycled content as a percentage of total input material.

epdUrl.description: URL to the Environmental Product Declaration (EPD).

ceMarking.description: Whether the product carries CE marking under EU CPR.
